 Jalen Williams, Jalen Suggs suffer gruesome injuries
 October 26, 2026 
 FASTBREAK.COM.PH 
 Share this FASTBREAK story:
 Oklahoma City Thunder star Jalen Williams and Orlando Magic guard Jalen Suggs suffered injuries during their respective NBA games on Sunday (Monday in the Philippines), raising concerns for their teams as they await further medical evaluations.
 Williams sustained a serious injury to his lower leg or ankle during the Thunder’s game against the Los Angeles Clippers after attempting a dunk in the fourth quarter. He landed awkwardly and had to be carried off the court on a stretcher.
 The extent of Williams’ injury remained unclear, with further evaluation and test results needed to determine its severity.
 Suggs, meanwhile, injured his right knee in Orlando’s matchup against the New York Knicks. The Magic guard went down after his knee buckled while attempting a fast-break layup.
 Unlike Williams, whose injury occurred after a dunk attempt, Suggs appeared to suffer a non-contact injury. He was helped off the floor as the team awaited further test results.
 Both players’ conditions remained uncertain following Sunday’s games, leaving their respective teams waiting for medical updates on the severity of the injuries and their potential impact on the season. (Adrian Co)
